content: Quick update on guest experience scores — we hit 4.2 this week which is below our 5.0 target. The check-in delays are directly impacting scores. Legacy system issue must be resolved urgently.
Survey results are in — training support scored only 3.8 out of 7 across all teams. This is our lowest score. We need immediate action on L&D program before Q3 performance reviews.
Freiburg renovation update — Phase 1 complete. Guest rooms on floors 2 and 3 fully renovated. Team morale is high. On track to finish by December 2026.
Reminder — Q3 survey opens Monday. Please complete it by Friday. Last quarter only 22 out of 38 employees responded. We need better participation to get accurate data.
IT confirmed — legacy system API wrapper ready for testing. If tests pass this week — Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative can resume. Deadline might still be achievable if we work weekends.
